author: Secretmink
quote:
Does not live up to the hype, or even the standards set by Rockstar themselves. Story and characters are utterly flat and boring, especially the main two characters. Jason and Lucia's relationship is as shallow as a puddle. The dialogue is stilted and disney-slop-HR coded. 
Missions have not evolved and have in fact regressed from previous GTA titles. Same formula, tons of QTEs. Feels like you have little autonomy as a player, wouldn't be as bad if the writing wasn't terrible.
The open world and random interactions are the best part of this game, but I have a hard time saying it's any better than RDR2, which this game obviously takes inspiration from.
Nothing about GTA 6 makes me excited to return to it. Save your money.
